Restore those dark arched source brows and their attentive serious mood without adding facial hair or changing the remaining features. This is visible source evidence under visible-source-differences-v1, not low-resolution speculation. The fine anchor/wreath badge internals and minute temple hair texture cannot be resolved exactly and are recorded as evidence limits rather than independent rejection grounds. Mascot identity, white naval cap/black band/gold badge-and-braid groups, neutral closed mouth, no eyewear or added beard, dark broad-lapel coat, white pointed shirt collar/dark patterned tie, head/torso direction, close crop and pale grey-green full painted backdrop otherwise inspected. Collar meets the broad short base continuously with contact shading, without pinching, floating cloth, clipping or a cream bib. No source note/frame exists or was invented. Raw is genuinely alpha255 throughout; full white/cyan/alpha show no hole or missing backdrop. Rejection concerns brows only, not opacity; measured values are retained under visible-alpha-v1.
